summary: The declared requirements of the four contract families this greenfield delivery is answered against: the published interface, the platform invariants, the operational observation the environment reports, and the integrity of the register snapshot the delivery carries.

clauses.subject: asset-performance-interface-contract
clauses.summary: the published view carries the approved interface version and every declared field

clauses.subject: asset-observation-invariant
clauses.summary: no observation falls outside the declared measurement range and no alert severity is unowned

clauses.subject: asset-feed-completeness-signal
clauses.summary: the feed run completed and finished before the declared cutoff

clauses.subject: asset-register-snapshot
clauses.summary: the delivered register snapshot is the approved one and left no asset code unmatched
